name: Froberg Vegetable & Fruit Farm
description: Froberg Vegetable & Fruit Farm is a family-run pumpkin patch in Satsumas, TX. It grows Strawberries, Citrus, Oranges, Lemons, and Pumpkins, with picking through spring, autumn, and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
